package.name: lexium_cobot_description
package.description: URDF/xacro description of the Schneider Electric Lexium Cobot LXMRL03S0000 reconstructed from the 12 visual STL meshes provided by the user (in "planta Schneider/Cobot/"). Articulated 6-DOF revolute chain with joint limits matching the LXMRL03S0000 datasheet. Used standalone (display_l03s.launch) and also as the cobot of the schneider_cell_description planta (V30 "hanging cobot" layout).
